outcome: use of uterotonics (excluding prophylactic oxytocin) or Bakri balloon
cohort: The study participants were 8,623 term (>=37 weeks) singletons, of whom 2,691 had cesarean deliveries.
finding: Composite maternal hemorrhagic outcomes were significantly higher in unscheduled cesarean deliveries compared to scheduled cesarean deliveries.
mod_finding: Unscheduled cesarean deliveries were associated with a two-fold higher rate of composite maternal hemorrhagic outcomes and a three-fold higher risk of blood transfusion and surgical interventions for postpartum hemorrhage compared to scheduled cesarean deliveries.
